entities.summary: Koh Rong is an island in Preah Sihanouk province, Cambodia. It is the second largest island of Cambodia. The word Rong might refer to an old term for "cave" or "tunnel". It can also refer to the Old Khmer word for shelter, adding up to Shelter Island.
